observations.footwork: Shuffling laterally across the gym floor from left to right, maintaining an athletic base.
observations.guard: Hands held high in a boxing guard, elbows tucked in.
observations.upper_body: Torso slightly rotated right, moving smoothly with the feet.
observations.distance: Maintaining distance from background people and heavy bags.

observations.footwork: Feet plant firmly on the ground, weight shifts to support the punch.
observations.guard: Right hand extends for the punch, left hand remains up guarding the chin.
observations.upper_body: Right arm extends fully straight, torso rotates into the strike.
observations.distance: Fighter in a striking posture within the middle of the gym.
observations.notable: Punch thrown while moving, maintaining balance and rhythm.

observations.footwork: Resuming lateral movement to the right, shuffling across the gym.
observations.guard: Hands return to a high guard position.
observations.upper_body: Torso faces the direction of travel, relaxed but alert.
observations.distance: Continuing to move across the open gym floor.
observations.notable: Smooth transition back to footwork after the punch.

movement_events.detail: Lateral shuffle movement across the gym from left to right.
Right straight punch fully extended, thrown while moving.
Punch retracted back to the guard, returning to a neutral stance.
Continuing lateral movement across the gym.
